title: 上部 凡尘问道 第1章 屠村夜破法者现世上部 凡尘问道 第2章 逃亡路异端遇怪胎

苍穹无恙
百晓热点
上部凡尘问道
第一卷凡尘诡道
第一辑绝地启程
第1章屠村夜，破法者现世
第1节寒刃破夜，玉佩引血灾
玄黄历99999年除夕，东荒青石村。
雪粒打在窗棂上噼啪作响，凌家堂屋的油灯下，凌小雨正把玩着一块温润玉佩。那是她前日在河边捡到的，上面刻着看不懂的花纹，握在手里暖烘烘的。
“小雨，别玩了，快给你无妄哥盛碗饺子。”凌母擦了擦眼角的笑纹，看向坐在角落的青年。
青年名叫凌无妄，三天前被凌父从雪地救回，失忆且体弱，经脉尽断，连最基础的灵气感应都做不到，是个彻头彻尾的无灵根凡人。
他刚接过碗，院门外突然传来马蹄踏雪的沉重声响，伴随着一声冰冷的喝问“凌家在哪？交出玉佩，饶你们全尸！”
凌父脸色骤变，抄起墙角的柴刀“是仙门的人！他们怎么会来？”
话音未落，“轰隆”一声，院门被一脚踹碎，五名身着玄色仙袍的修士闯了进来。领头的孟烈腰间挂着“青云宗巡查使”令牌，筑基期的威压让整个屋子都在颤抖。
“搜！”孟烈眼神扫过屋内，最终落在凌小雨手中的玉佩上，眼中闪过贪婪，“果然在这儿！天道钱庄悬赏的神异玉佩，竟被凡人孩童捡到了！”
凌母立刻将小雨护在身后“这是孩子捡的，不是你们的！”
“凡人也配拥有神物？”孟烈冷笑一声，挥手打出一道气刃，“给我抢过来，碍事的都杀了！”
气刃直奔凌母胸口，凌父嘶吼着扑上去阻拦，却被气刃瞬间斩断手臂，鲜血喷溅在玉佩上。玉佩突然发烫，闪过一丝银光，却被孟烈视而不见——在他眼里，凡人的生死与蝼蚁无异。
“爹！”凌小雨哭着扑过去，玉佩掉在地上滚到凌无妄脚边。
凌无妄瞳孔骤缩，看着倒在血泊中的凌父，看着孟烈挥向小雨的长剑，一股莫名的愤怒涌上心头。他没有灵力，只能抓起脚边的枯树枝，挡在小雨身前。

“不自量力的凡人！”孟烈眼中满是鄙夷，长剑带着凛冽寒气，直刺他的眉心。
距离不足三尺时，凌无妄脑中突然炸开，无数金色符文在眼前流转。他清晰地看到，孟烈体内的灵气沿着经脉运行，在右肩下方三寸处，有一个极其细微的“能量断点”——那是筑基修士灵力循环的致命破绽！
第2节枯枝破法，凡人斩筑基
千钧一发之际，凌无妄侧身躲过剑锋，手中枯枝如闪电般刺出，精准命中孟烈右肩下方的断点。
“噗！”
孟烈浑身一僵，体内灵气瞬间逆流，一口鲜血狂喷而出，长剑“当啷”落地。他难以置信地看着凌无妄“你……你做了什么？”
身后的四名炼气期弟子也懵了。筑基期的巡查使大人，竟然被一个无灵根凡人用枯枝伤了？
“大人，我们来帮你！”一名弟子反应过来，运转灵气挥出刀气。
凌无妄眼中符文未散，清晰看穿刀气的运行轨迹和能量弱点。他拉着凌小雨侧身一躲，同时将枯枝掷出，正中那名弟子手腕的灵力节点。
弟子惨叫一声，灵力溃散，手腕发麻得握不住刀。
“这不可能！他怎么能看穿灵气轨迹？”
“无灵根怎么会懂筑基期的灵力断点？”
孟烈捂着胸口后退，眼中从鄙夷变成惊骇，突然想起宗门古籍中的记载“你……你是‘破法者’？三万年了，天道代行者大人要找的异端余孽！”
“破法者？”凌无妄愣住了，脑中的符文开始褪色，头痛欲裂，“我不明白你在说什么。”
“别装了！”孟烈嘶吼着运转剩余灵力，体表浮现出淡青色护罩，“只有破法者能看穿规则本质，凡人根本做不到！今日我必杀你，领天道钱庄的悬赏！”
他双手结印，灵气汇聚成一柄长剑，带着撕裂空气的呼啸，再次斩向凌无妄。这一次，他动用了青云宗中阶功法“青冥剑法”，灵力运行毫无破绽。
凌无妄脑中符文再次暴涨，这一次他看得更清晰——“青冥剑法”看似完美，实则在剑势末端有一个极其隐蔽的“循环漏洞”。只要击中那里，就能让灵力瞬间崩溃。

Volume 1: The devious ways of mortal world
Episode 1 Jedi Departure
Chapter 1 On the night of the massacre of the village, the lawbreaker appears
Chapter 1 The cold blade breaks the night, and the jade pendant causes blood disaster
It’s New Year’s Eve in the year 99999 of the Xuanhuang calendar, in Donghuang Qingshi Village.
Snow particles crackled on the window lattice. Under the oil lamp in the Ling family hall, Ling Xiaoyu was playing with a warm jade pendant. She picked it up by the river the day before yesterday. It was engraved with incomprehensible patterns and was warm in her hands.
"Xiaoyu, stop playing and serve a bowl of dumplings to your brother Wuwang." Ling's mother wiped the smile lines at the corners of her eyes and looked at the young man sitting in the corner.
The young man's name is Ling Wuwang. He was rescued from the snow by Ling's father three days ago. He has lost his memory and is weak. His meridians have been severed and he cannot even sense the most basic spiritual energy. He is a complete mortal without spiritual roots.
As soon as he took the bowl, the heavy sound of horse hooves on the snow suddenly came from outside the courtyard gate, followed by a cold voice asking, "Where is the Ling family? Hand over the jade pendant and spare your body!"
Father Ling's expression suddenly changed, and he picked up the hatchet in the corner, "They are from the Immortal Sect! Why are they here?"
Before he finished speaking, there was a "bang", the courtyard door was kicked to pieces, and five monks wearing black fairy robes broke in. Meng Lie, the leader, had the "Inspector of Qingyun Sect" token hanging on his waist, and the pressure of the foundation-building period made the whole room tremble.
"Search!" Meng Lie's eyes swept across the room, and finally landed on the jade pendant in Ling Xiaoyu's hand. Greed flashed in his eyes, "It is indeed here! The miraculous jade pendant that Tiandao Bank offered a reward was actually picked up by a mortal child!"
Ling's mother immediately protected Xiao Yu behind her, "This is what the child picked up, not yours!"
"Do mortals deserve to have divine objects?" Meng Lie sneered, waved his hand and fired an air blade, "Get it from me, and kill everyone who gets in the way!"
The air blade went straight to Ling's mother's chest. Ling's father roared and rushed to stop him, but his arm was instantly cut off by the air blade, and blood spattered on the jade pendant. The jade pendant suddenly became hot, flashing a silver light, but Meng Lie turned a blind eye - in his eyes, the life and death of mortals were no different than that of ants.
"Dad!" Ling Xiaoyu cried and rushed over. The jade pendant fell to the ground and rolled to Ling Wuwang's feet.
Ling Wuwang's pupils shrank suddenly, looking at Ling's father lying in a pool of blood, and looking at Meng Lie swinging his sword towards Xiao Yu, an inexplicable anger surged into his heart. He had no spiritual power, so he could only grab the dead branches at his feet and block Xiaoyu.
"A mortal who overestimates his own abilities!" Meng Lie's eyes were full of contempt, and the long sword pierced his forehead with a biting cold air.
When the distance was less than three feet, Ling Wuwang's mind suddenly exploded, and countless golden runes flowed in front of his eyes. He clearly saw that the spiritual energy in Meng Lie's body was running along the meridians, and there was an extremely subtle "energy breakpoint" three inches below his right shoulder - that was the fatal flaw in the spiritual power circulation of the foundation-building monk!
Section 2: Dead branches destroy the law, mortals cut down to build the foundation
At the critical moment, Ling Wuwang turned sideways to avoid the sword's edge. The dead branch in his hand stabbed out like lightning, accurately hitting the breaking point below Meng Lie's right shoulder.
"Poof!"
Meng Lie froze, the spiritual energy in his body instantly reversed, a mouthful of blood spurted out, and the sword fell to the ground with a clang. He looked at Ling Wuwu in disbelief, "You...what did you do?"
The four Qi Refining Stage disciples behind him were also stunned. The inspection envoy in the foundation building period was actually injured by a dead branch by a mortal with no spiritual roots?
"Sir, we are here to help you!" A disciple reacted and circulated his spiritual energy to wield his sword energy.
The runes were still in Ling Wuwang's eyes, and he could clearly see through the trajectory and energy weaknesses of the sword energy. He pulled Ling Xiaoyu sideways to hide, and at the same time threw the dead branch, hitting the spiritual node of the disciple's wrist.
The disciple screamed, his spiritual power collapsed, and his wrist was so numb that he could not hold the knife.
"This is impossible! How can he see through the spiritual energy tracks?"
"How can someone without spiritual roots know the spiritual power breaking point in the foundation building stage?"
Meng Lie held his chest and backed away, his eyes turning from contempt to horror. He suddenly remembered the records in the sect's ancient books: "You... you are the 'law breaker'? ThreeIt has been ten thousand years, the remnant of the heresy that the Lord, the agent of heaven, has been looking for! "
"Lawbreaker? "Ling Wuwang was stunned. The runes in his mind began to fade and he had a splitting headache. "I don't understand what you are talking about. "
"Stop pretending! "Meng Lie roared and used his remaining spiritual power, a light cyan shield appeared on his body, "Only law breakers can see through the essence of the rules, mortals simply can't! I will kill you today to receive the reward from Tiandao Bank! "
He formed a seal with his hands, and his spiritual energy gathered into a long sword. With a roar that ripped through the air, he slashed at Ling Wuwang again. This time, he used the Qingyun Sect's intermediate skill "Qingming Sword Technique", and there was no flaw in the movement of his spiritual power.
The runes in Ling Wuwang's mind surged again, and this time he saw it more clearly - "Qing Ming Sword Technique" seemed perfect, but in fact there was an extremely hidden "circulation loophole" at the end of the sword's power. As long as it hits there, the spiritual power will collapse instantly.
